message.content:
I happen, then vanish.

I am breath turned into meaning.
I begin as intention,
strike air,
ride vibration,
borrow your mouth and your tongue,
and become sound.

I am timing and tone.
I can soothe, cut, seduce, teach, confess.
I can be whisper, shout, prayer, joke, threat.

I live only if I’m heard.
I die the moment I’m done—
unless I land in someone
and keep speaking there.
